document_notes: Page 75 of PIR contains entry 443 (P. Afranius Flavianus), which is highly relevant to the PROVINCIA corpus due to his explicit attestation as 'Legatus Aug. pro praetore Pannoniae inferioris' in 114 AD.

entries.relevance_notes: Explicitly attested as 'Legatus Aug. pro praetore Pannoniae inferioris' in a military diploma dated September 1, 114 AD.

segments.name_variants: P. Afranius Flavianus t. 3; ᾿Αφράνιος Φλαουιανός t. 1; ᾿Αφράνιος Φλαβιανός t. 2.
segments.identification_and_sources: memoratur in monumento Ephesio C. Vibii Salutaris Inscr. Br. Mus. 3, 2 p. 133 n. 481, plenius Forsch. in Eph. 2 n. 27 p. 129. 130. 136 (1), in altero titulo Ephesio Jahresh. 7 B 42 (2), in dipl. mil. III p. 867 = 1975 (3).
segments.offices_and_career: Legatus pro praetore C. Aquillii Proculi proconsulis provinciae Asiae a. 103/104 t. 1. Legatus Aug. pro praetore Pannoniae inferioris d. 1 m. Sept. a. 114 t. 3. Proconsul provinciae Asiae imperante Hadriano t. 2, qui titulus cum Hadrianus iam audiat Ζεὺς ᾿Ολύμπιος neque vero Ephesii altera neocoria exornati sint, c. a. 130 incisus videtur (cf. Weber Hadr. 214). Consulatu c. a. 115 functum esse cum ex intervallo, quod tum inter consulatum et proconsulatum Asiae intercedere solebat, tum ex tempore legationis Pannonicae concludi potest.
segments.governorship_attestation: Legatus Aug. pro praetore Pannoniae inferioris d. 1 m. Sept. a. 114 t. 3.
segments.family_and_social_relations: Cum in decreto senatus populique Ephesiorum monumento Vibi Salutaris inserto Aquillius Proculus proconsul et Afranius Flavianus legatus eius afferantur ὡς γνή[σιοι π]ολεῖται [ἡμῶν αὐτοί (t. 1 col. 2 v. 80. 81), inde nolim conicere Proculum Flavianumque origine fuisse Ephesios; magis crediderim utrumque ab Ephesiis civitate donatum esse.
segments.prosopographical_commentary: The date of his consulship is inferred to be around 115 AD based on the interval between his legation in Pannonia and his subsequent proconsulship of Asia under Hadrian.
segments.bibliography_or_cross_references: Inscr. Br. Mus. 3, 2 p. 133 n. 481; Forsch. in Eph. 2 n. 27 p. 129. 130. 136; Jahresh. 7 B 42; dipl. mil. III p. 867 = 1975; Weber Hadr. 214.

career_factoids.exact_text: Legatus pro praetore C. Aquillii Proculi proconsulis provinciae Asiae a. 103/104 t. 1
notes: Served as legatus to the proconsul C. Aquillius Proculus.
Inferred from the chronological gap between his Pannonian legation and his proconsulship of Asia.

career_factoids.exact_text: Proconsul provinciae Asiae imperante Hadriano t. 2
notes: Proconsul of Asia under Hadrian; the inscription is dated to around 130 AD.

related_persons.relation_context: Proconsul of Asia, under whom Afranius Flavianus served as legatus.
Flavianus is mentioned in his Ephesian monument.
